title: Beyoncé’s foundation gives $50,000 to youth charity
summary_full: In a generous move, Beyoncé’s foundation, BeyGood, has granted $50,000 to In a Perfect World, which concentrates on youth empowerment. This financial support will help expand their educational and leadership initiatives, aiming to reach more young people in need. With its past achievements touching over 50,000 lives worldwide, the organization is crucial in filling the gaps left by funding shortages in schools, striving to uplift disadvantaged communities.
